name: Laid-off Midwest People Operations manager rebuilding a focused pipeline

constraints: In-house HR leadership rather than agency recruiter work
context.company_awareness: Knows some former-sector employers but must widen the list.

trigger: After a layoff, the manager creates several job alerts but finds agency recruiting, generic operations and duplicate reposts mixed with relevant HR roles.

searches_run.query: senior people operations manager remote US jobs
searches_run.observation: Retrieved direct employer/ATS pages and aggregators. The Mixpanel role redirected to its current company board with an error parameter when inspected; the fetched board did not list the searched US role. A Murmuration role returned 410, underscoring availability uncertainty.

searches_run.query: in house HR manager remote jobs exclude staffing recruiting agencies
searches_run.observation: Combined retrieval included a third-party 'for our client' repost, remote HR aggregators and in-house responsibilities. It did not establish a reliable exclusion filter. Advertiser identity and actual work scope are separate questions.

sources.title: Senior People Operations Manager search result / current Mixpanel board
sources.supports: Retrieved role snippet described internal HR systems; direct open redirected to https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/mixpanel?error=true. Inspected board lists a London People role, not the searched US opening; no current availability claim.

sources.title: Senior People Operations Manager | Murmuration on Workable
sources.supports: Retrieved internal payroll/benefits/lifecycle duties; direct open returned 410 Gone.

sources.title: Senior Manager People Operations | Docusign
sources.supports: Retrieved employer snippet names US/Illinois remote and global employee-lifecycle work; current availability not independently verified.

sources.title: Senior People Operations Manager | Ladders on LinkedIn
sources.supports: Retrieved third-party posting uses 'for our client' framing; does not prove the underlying job is agency recruiting.

best_entry_page.primary_query: in house people operations manager remote US jobs
best_entry_page.promise: Find covered employers' HR openings and compare responsibilities, state restrictions and original job links before building an application pipeline.
best_entry_page.cta: Search People Operations and HR management roles, then save relevant indexed openings and employer alerts.
proof_needed: Role classification separating HR operations, recruiting and generic operations
Direct employer identity alongside posting source
Evidence of closed-role handling and duplicate management
Tracker scope explicitly limited to demonstrated indexed-job saving

conversion_objections: Remote US may exclude my state.
Agency-posted does not necessarily mean agency work.
Company selection is hard when I need to widen the search quickly.
A tracker that omits outside applications leaves me maintaining a spreadsheet too.
I cannot afford endless stale listings.

avoid_targeting.reason: The applicant needs a personal search tool, not an employer ATS.

avoid_targeting.query: all remote HR jobs guaranteed active
avoid_targeting.reason: Complete coverage and freshness are not guaranteed.

message_to_founder: Simulation: I know how hiring works, but searching for my own next role is still disorganized. Help me distinguish real internal People roles from recruiting work and verify state restrictions; I also need a clear answer about which applications your tracker can actually hold.

Source claims and role availability can change; product fit uses the supplied repository brief.
